summary: Digiview provides a distraction-free web interface for watching videos from YouTube. Official documentation is currently available in French only. It is built using Node.js and PHP under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: Users who want a minimal interface for viewing YouTube content without standard platform clutter. It suits self-hosters looking for lightweight, open-source web applications.
watchOut: The project has no tagged releases and zero repository stars, indicating very early development or an experimental state. You should expect potential gaps in documentation and maintenance.
deployNotes: Hosting this typically requires configuring a web server to handle PHP alongside a Node.js runtime environment. You will also need a standard reverse proxy setup to terminate TLS.
